bio: Hello! My name is Cat St. Hilaire. I’m in my 3rd year at the law school and this is my 3rd year as a proctor. I’m so excited to welcome you to the yard! I’m from Long Island, New York. I graduated from Cornell University in 2022 and spent my time before Harvard in Toronto on a Fulbright. I love to run, explore the cafes in Cambridge, and take hobby classes (always happy to give recommendations, I’ve tried pottery and sewing so far)! I can’t wait to get to know all of you over the next year! Community Yards Ivy Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
